_comment: Explicit tier pins. These WIN over the category rules in build_tiers.py. Put judgment calls here rather than contorting a rule. Format: '<item id>': [tier, 'why'].
_eggs: Cobbreeding Pokemon Eggs. Never materialise as a plain item id — the gacha dispatches `givepokemonegg` and Cobbreeding builds the egg server-side (ludichat.cobbreeding.PokemonEgg), so each pool is tiered as its own entry. ANCHOR: 'Pokemon Egg is rare' — the rare pool is T2 and the rest are graded around it.
cobbreeding:egg_rare: Rare Pokemon Egg — rare pool. The anchor: a Pokemon Egg is Rare.
cobbreeding:egg_ultra_rare: Ultra Rare Pokemon Egg — ultra_rare pool (includes a Battle Bond Greninja)
cobbreeding:egg_shiny: Shiny Egg — guaranteed shiny from the rare|uncommon pool
_keys: Gacha crate keys. These are VANILLA items carrying a custom_data{gacha_key} tag (see custom-mods/cobblemon-gacha/.../KeyItems.kt) — an untagged one will not open a crate, so they are tiered as their own entries rather than as the base item.
gacha:common_key: Common Crate key — minecraft:trial_key + gacha_key tag
gacha:rare_key: Rare Crate key — minecraft:ominous_trial_key + gacha_key tag
gacha:ultra_key: Ultra Crate key — minecraft:nether_star + gacha_key tag. Not obtainable outside quests and events.
gacha:pokemon_key: Pokemon Crate key — minecraft:turtle_egg + gacha_key tag
_T5_mythic: Gates a box legendary/mythical, or is a guaranteed-catch. Should never be a routine reward.
legendarymonuments:azure_flute: Opens the Hall of Origin — ARCEUS. Ultra crate jackpot at 0.8%.
minecraft:totem_of_undying: Zacian summon gate. Ultra crate 1.6% is the only intended source.
cobblemon:master_ball: Guaranteed catch. Ultra crate only, 2x at 6.5%.
legendarymonuments:celestica_flute: Crafts into the Azure Flute. Same gate, one step removed.
_TX_disabled: Intentionally not obtainable. Recipe banned and/or stripped from loot.

mega_showdown:rusted_sword: Zacian-Crowned gate. Craft banned (was iron_sword + netherite_scrap + fire_charge, far too cheap) — intended to be chest loot instead. NOT YET PLACED IN ANY CHEST.

_T4_legendary: Summons or permanently unlocks a legendary/forme. One-per-player scale.
mega_showdown:ash_cap: Uncraftable — craft banned by server-craft-bans; Ultra crate only
_T3_epic: Permanent competitive power, or a hard-gated component. Meaningful chase reward.
cobblemon:ability_patch: Hidden ability. Deliberately pulled from the Ultra crate.
legendarymonuments:origin_ingot: Repairs the Red Chain — component for a T4
legendarymonuments:lightstone_shard: 9 craft into a T4 Light Stone
legendarymonuments:darkstone_shard: 9 craft into a T4 Dark Stone
cobblemon:held_item_voucher: Redeems for a premium held item
cobblemon:beast_ball: Best-in-slot for Ultra Beasts, not purchasable
_T2_rare: Strong but repeatable. Fine as a headline reward for a real challenge.
cobblemon:rare_candy: Instant level. Purchasable, but heavy demand keeps it scarce.
cobblemon:exp_candy_xl: Feedstock for IV candies — heavy consumption keeps it scarce despite being on the shelf
minecraft:beacon: $50,000 — the single most expensive market item
minecraft:nether_star: Base item for the Ultra Crate key — awarding one reads as awarding a key, even though an untagged star will not open a crate
legendarymonuments:golem_scrap: Golem crafting material — a component, not a gate
cobblemon:exp_candy_l: Feedstock for IV candies — heavy consumption keeps it scarce despite being on the shelf
minecraft:diamond: Common enough at this point in progression
_T0_common: Filler. Safe to hand out in bulk.
